headline: Mitsotakis: Early Repayment of Debt a National Success - Announcement of New Benefits
summary: Greek Prime Minister Mitsotakis called early debt repayment a national success, saying it gives greater fiscal freedom. The government aims to reduce debt below 110% by 2031 and announced new benefits.
why: Public debt levels and early repayments shape a sovereign's borrowing costs, credit standing and room for fiscal spending.
